title: What If Antibiotics Stopped Working?

scenes.text: What if antibiotics stopped working? The bad news is it has already started.
In 2021, resistant bacteria directly killed over a million people. They played a part in nearly five million deaths.
The World Health Organization warns that cesareans, hip replacements, chemotherapy and transplants would become very high risk.
Among people over seventy, resistance deaths rose by more than eighty percent between nineteen ninety and twenty twenty-one.
A major study forecasts about thirty-nine million deaths directly from resistant infections between twenty twenty-five and twenty fifty.
It is not a switch that flips. It is slow, one resistant germ at a time, and the clock is already running.
